items.guidance: Find the schema.prisma file and check for a migrations folder next to it. If migrations exist, report npx prisma migrate deploy with its --schema path; if the project only uses prisma db push in an existing script, report that script. Confirm the prisma CLI is in the production image, and report which Dockerfile is meant for production, because Dockerfile.dev is a development file.

Check which app or package creates the @temporalio/worker Worker, and whether the pm2 configuration started by pnpm run pm2 runs it as its own process. Report that entry file, the pm2 process name, and the command that starts it.

Check whether runtime code in the backend or the Temporal worker imports a Temporal client to start workflows, or whether Temporal is used only by an optional feature. Report the files that use it, any setting that disables it, and that the docker-compose.yaml service temporal uses temporalio/auto-setup:1.28.1.
